newsitem.title: USA: BASKETBALL-SHERYL SWOOPES GIVES BIRTH TO BABY BOY.
newsitem.headline: BASKETBALL-SHERYL SWOOPES GIVES BIRTH TO BABY BOY.

text.p: Olympian Sheryl Swoopes, one of the marquee players in the Women's National Basketball Association, gave birth to a baby boy Wednesday.
The boy was named Jordan Eric Jackson. Mother and baby were reported resting comfortably and were expected home from the hospital before the weekend.
Swoopes was assigned to the Houston Rockets in the inaugural season of the WNBA but has not played because of her pregnancy.

"My husband and I are so happy that Jordan has finally arrived and that he is a healthy baby," said Swoopes. "Right now I'm focusing all my attention on my son, but I look forward to getting back into playing condition and joining the Houston Comets in the future."
Swoopes is expected to join the Comets in August. The 28-game WNBA season concludes August 24.
The 6-foot (1.83 metres) forward led Texas Tech to the 1994 national women's collegiate championship and was a member of the U.S. gold medal-winning Olympic team at the Atlanta Olympics.
